what: templates-tests-rule allows an integration test to drive a public library function; end-to-end tests still go through the CLI, HTTP or UI.
why: Owner rule after the pilot 1 run (Tom, 2026-10-20, PR #54): integration tests may enter through a public library function, e.g. pilot 1's build_context(); end-to-end tests and just qc still go through the CLI, HTTP or UI. ADR 0002 was rewritten in place and the spec followed it (owner yes: Tom, 2026-10-20).
evidence: Pilot 1 run: a target whose public surface is a library function could not be integration-tested under 'the test drives the app's CLI, HTTP or UI and calls no internal function', which contradicted rewritten ADR 0002.

what: templates-integrate-rule: only a repository created from a template has just integrate; a repository the kit did not create gains no factory recipe, agents run octo-feather-integrate and octo-feather-qc directly.
why: Hand-in repos must stay clean (PR #56, owner approved 2026-10-20); ADR 0017 was rewritten in place to match.
evidence: Pilot 1 (2026-10-20): the hand-in repo gained integrate/qc recipes in its justfile because the spec said every target defines them.

what: acceptance-same-gate: CI runs the same just check on a push to main and on a pull request once it is ready for review; a draft pull request runs no CI until marked ready.
why: Owner ruling 2026-10-27 (relayed by the director, lane gh201): CI runs only on the head that goes into a merge ask, in the kit and both templates; lanes mark the PR ready right before the merge ask. It cuts Actions minutes after the account hit its spending limit (runs 40540547106, 40542156602 not started).
evidence: templates/python and templates/typescript .github/workflows/check.yml now trigger on pull_request [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review] with the job skipped while draft, and on push to main only; the criterion said CI runs when any change is pushed.
